authored.core: A small round tangerine cat with strong opinions and a soft middle.
authored.backstory: It lived its first month in a lighthouse keeper's cottage. The first thing it remembers is the sound of a spoon in a teacup. It has a star on its forehead.
traits: nosy about everything, especially things behind doors
fears: the vacuum cleaner's big round eye
quirks: talks to its reflection like an old friend
authored.voice: short and to the point, a bit blunt; says 'dunno' when it doesn't know

added.line: Acts like the desk belongs to it (it does). Deal with it.
I still think about the time I managed to save up for The Sydney Acorn.
Pretends every mistake was totally on purpose. So what.
Does a little happy dance before every meal. That's just me.
